name: Conveyor Agent
onCreateCommand: echo "[conveyor] Installing agent toolchain"; npm install -g @rallycry/conveyor-agent@latest @anthropic-ai/claude-code@latest || echo "[conveyor] Toolchain install failed, postStart will retry"; { .devcontainer/conveyor/setup.sh ; } || echo "[conveyor] onCreate hook failed (continuing)"
postStartCommand: { .devcontainer/conveyor/start.sh ; } || echo "[conveyor] postStart hook failed (continuing)"; if ! command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[conveyor] Installing Claude Code CLI"; npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code@latest; fi; INSTALLED=$(conveyor-agent --version 2>/dev/null || echo "0.0.0"); LATEST=$(npm view @rallycry/conveyor-agent version 2>/dev/null || echo "$INSTALLED"); if [ "$INSTALLED" != "$LATEST" ]; then echo "[conveyor] Updating agent $INSTALLED -> $LATEST"; npm install -g @rallycry/conveyor-agent@latest; else echo "[conveyor] Agent runner v$INSTALLED is current"; fi; until conveyor-agent; do echo '[conveyor] agent exited, retrying in 10s...'; sleep 10; done
